title: Dinuclear platinum(II) complexes as the pattern for phosphate backbone binding: a new perspective for recognition of binding modes to DNA.
authors: Franich, Andjela A; Dordevic, Ivana S; Zivkovic, Marija D; Rajkovic, Snezana; Janjic, Goran V; Djuran, Milos I
journal: Journal of biological inorganic chemistry : JBIC : a publication of the Society of Biological Inorganic Chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双核铂配合物与DNA磷酸骨架的结合模式，使用光谱和对接方法，但对象为小分子-DNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The mechanism of action of most approved drugs in use today is based on their binding to specific proteins or DNA. One of the achievements of this research is a new perspective for recognition of binding modes to DNA by monitoring of changes in measured and stoichiometric values of absorbance at 260 nm. UV-Vis and IR spectroscopy, gel electrophoresis and docking study were used for investigation of binding properties of three dinuclear platinum(II) complexes containing different pyridine-based bridging ligands, [Pt(en)Cl(2)(mu-4,4'-bipy)]Cl(2).2H(2)O (Pt1), [Pt(en)Cl(2)(mu-bpa)]Cl(2).4H(2)O (Pt2) and [Pt(en)Cl(2)(mu-bpe)]Cl(2).4H(2)O (Pt3) to DNA (4,4'-bipy, bpa and bpe are 4,4'-bipyridine, 1,2-bis(4-pyridyl)ethane and 1,2-bis(4-pyridyl)ethene, respectively). In contrast to the system with well-known intercalated ligand (EtBr), covalently bound ligand (cis-Pt) and with minor groove binder (Hoechst 33258), which do not have significant differences in measured and stoichiometric values, the most pronounced deviations are recorded for two dinuclear platinum(II) complexes (Pt1 and Pt2), as a consequence of complex binding to the phosphate backbone and bending of DNA helix. The hydrolysis of complexes and changes in DNA conformation were also analysed as phenomena that may have an impact on the changes in absorbance.
abstract_zh: 目前大多数已批准药物的作用机制基于其与特定蛋白质或DNA的结合。本研究的成果之一是通过监测260 nm处吸光度的测量值和化学计量值变化，为识别与DNA的结合模式提供了新视角。采用紫外-可见光谱（UV-Vis）和红外光谱（IR）、凝胶电泳及分子对接研究，考察了三种含不同吡啶基桥联配体的双核铂(II)配合物[Pt(en)Cl(2)(mu-4,4'-bipy)]Cl(2).2H(2)O (Pt1)、[Pt(en)Cl(2)(mu-bpa)]Cl(2).4H(2)O (Pt2)和[Pt(en)Cl(2)(mu-bpe)]Cl(2).4H(2)O (Pt3)与DNA的结合性质（其中4,4'-bipy、bpa和bpe分别为4,4'-联吡啶、1,2-双(4-吡啶基)乙烷和1,2-双(4-吡啶基)乙烯）。与已知插入配体（EtBr）、共价结合配体（cis-Pt）及小沟结合剂（Hoechst 33258）的系统相比，这些系统在测量值和化学计量值上无显著差异，而两种双核铂(II)配合物（Pt1和Pt2）记录了最明显的偏差，这归因于配合物与磷酸骨架的结合及DNA螺旋的弯曲。此外，还分析了配合物的水解和DNA构象变化作为可能影响吸光度变化的现象。
